'''Wit al'Seen''' is a farmer from the [[Two Rivers]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Wit al'Seen|WS}} He is [[Jac al'Seen|Jac al'Seen's]] cousin.{{ref||WS}}

== Appearance ==
He stocky, square-shouldered, and is bald.

== Activities ==
He helps defend [[Emond's Field]] against the invading [[Trolloc]] army.{{ref/book|4|56}}
